Programming Language Reference: C#
Version: C# 12 / 13 (.NET 8 / 9)
Syntax: Modern component-oriented language executing on the .NET Common Language Runtime (CLR).
Semantics: Managed code execution, JIT compilation, LINQ query expressions, async/await task-based asynchronous pattern (TAP).
Type System: Strong static typing with unified type system (System.Object), value types (structs), reference types (classes, records), nullable reference types.
Memory Model: Managed generational garbage collection (Server GC / Workstation GC), Span / Memory for allocation-free slicing.
Concurrency: Task Parallel Library (TPL), async/await, Channels, lock statement, System.Threading.Channels.
Error Handling: Structured exception handling with try/catch/when/finally blocks.
Standard APIs: System.Collections.Generic, System.Linq, System.Text.Json, System.Threading.Tasks, System.IO
Specification: ECMA-334 Standard / Microsoft C# Language Design
Official Docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/csharp/
